title: Monthly Clothing Swap
venue: Larcom City Hall, City Council Chambers, 2nd Floor
description:
Join the Office of Sustainability and Innovations for monthly clothing swaps on the third Thursday of each month! These are a perfect way to give your gently used clothes a new home. And you might just find an item of clothing you have been looking for, without having to buy it new.

​​How it works: Each person can bring up to 5 items of clothing in good condition (no rips, holes, stains, or unwashed items please!). Accessories are also welcome. You can take clothing without bringing anything, or bring clothing without taking anything. This is a completely free event.

description:

title: Ann Arbor Farmers Market Saturday Market Regular Hours
Fuller Park: FREE Party in the Park
description:
Get ready for afternoons filled with music, games, creativity and community fun as the free Party in the Parks series returns this summer — with two events across Ann Arbor parks! Enjoy live music from local performers, hands-on crafts, lawn games and food.


2026 Party in the Parks Schedule:
* Saturday, June 27 — Fuller Park: Performances by the Ann Arbor Civic Band followed by the Island Guys Steel Drum Duo. 1519 Fuller Road


* Saturday, Aug. 15 — West Park


Bring your friends, family, picnic blankets and dancing shoes for a fun-filled afternoon in the park! You can also hot dogs, chicken/philly and fish sandwiches, mac + cheese, potato salad, desserts/drinks from Touch of Honey food truck.
